name: knos_oidc
docs: OIDC on Solana: verifies an RS256 token from GitHub Actions or GitLab CI on chain. No admin, immutable.
A native program: this file is written by hand from programs/knos_oidc/src/lib.rs and checked by tests/test_idl.py.
Instruction data is the discriminant byte, then the arguments in order, little-endian, with no padding.
An argument or field of type bytes is raw and runs to the end: it has no length prefix.

instructions.name: Write
docs: Writes the token (the compact JWT) into the token account, created on first use and sized for `total` bytes (at most 8192).
Chunks may be sent in any order, several per transaction.

accounts.name: payer
accounts.desc: Pays the rent; only this account can write, step or close the token

instructions.name: Step
docs: Computes s^65537 mod n a few squarings at a time. The call that finishes the 16 squarings checks the PKCS#1 v1.5 SHA-256 encoding,
that alg is RS256 and that iss is the key's issuer, decodes the payload in place and marks the account VERIFIED.
2048-bit keys: Step(8), Step(8). 4096-bit keys: Step(2), Step(3) three times, Step(4), Step(1): the finishing call also hashes and
decodes the whole token, and with two squarings it runs out of compute units once the token is long.

accounts.name: payer
accounts.desc: The payer that wrote the token

accounts.name: key
accounts.desc: A ready key account of this program: PDA ["key", [issuer], sha256(n)]

instructions.name: Close
docs: Closes the token account; the rent goes back to the payer.

accounts.name: payer
accounts.desc: The payer that wrote the token

instructions.name: RegisterKey
docs: Creates the key account of an issuer's RSA modulus. Allowed when sha256(n) is a genesis constant of the binary, or when `attest`
is a VERIFIED GitHub token of the pinned rotate workflow whose audience is knos-oidc:key:<issuer>:<sha256(n) hex>. Anyone may send it.

accounts.name: attest
accounts.desc: A VERIFIED token account naming this key; left out for a genesis key

instructions.name: KeyParams
docs: The key's Montgomery constants, checked on chain; the key is usable after this. Anyone may send it.

accounts.name: Token
docs: PDA ["tok", payer, id], id = sha256 of the compact JWT. 626 bytes, then the token.
stage: 0 writing, 1 stepping, 2 VERIFIED. issuer: 0 GitHub Actions, 1 GitLab CI. Once VERIFIED, the decoded claims (JSON) are the
payloadLen bytes at payloadOff, counted from the start of the account, and exp is the token's exp claim.
A consumer checks that the account's owner is this program, that stage is 2 and that the clock is under exp + 3600.

accounts.name: Key
docs: PDA ["key", [issuer], sha256(n)], n = the RSA modulus, big-endian. 8 bytes, then n and R^2 mod n as little-endian u32 limbs
(limbs is 64 for a 2048-bit key, 128 for a 4096-bit key; 4 * limbs bytes each). ready is 1 after KeyParams.

errors.name: Json
errors.msg: The token is not three parts, or a part is not a JSON object

errors.name: Claim
errors.msg: A claim is missing or of the wrong type

errors.name: Length
errors.msg: Token too long or chunk out of range

errors.name: SignatureLength
errors.msg: The signature is not as long as the modulus, or not below it

errors.name: KeyParams
errors.msg: The key or its Montgomery constants are wrong

errors.name: Accounts
errors.msg: A wrong account, or a missing signature

errors.name: Key
errors.msg: Not a ready key of this program, or not the key the token started with

errors.name: Stage
errors.msg: The account is in the wrong stage for this instruction

errors.name: Issuer
errors.msg: Unknown issuer, or iss is not the key's issuer

errors.name: Untrusted
errors.msg: The key is not in genesis and there is no valid attestation

errors.name: Attestation
errors.msg: The attestation's claims do not name this key from the pinned rotate workflow

errors.name: AttestationExpired
errors.msg: The attestation is more than an hour past its expiry
